notes: «عن جده الحسن بن راشد» is one link (rule 7); «(2)» and «(3)» are footnote marks and «(رضي الله عنه)» and «(عليه السلام)» honorifics, all left out
The Imam is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is an ordinary narrator (owner ruling 2 covers only words after the chain); the saying is his, and he is the last link
